entities.summary:
Julio Mangada Rosenörn was a Spanish Republican Army officer during the Second Spanish Republic and the Spanish Civil War (1936–1939), a pivotal figure in the Republican forces' fight against fascist Nationalists.

As a key military strategist, Mangada Rosenörn played a crucial role in the Battle of the Ebro (August–October 1938), one of the bloodiest battles of the war, which ultimately ended in a Republican defeat.

Despite the war's outcome, Mangada Rosenörn's legacy as a Republican officer has endured, with his actions and decisions contributing to the Republican forces' resistance against Nationalist advances.

"The spirit of the people will not be defeated," Mangada Rosenörn said in a 1938 interview, reflecting his unwavering commitment to the Republican cause.
